settings.heading:
Built in two parts.
Closed with a zip.
settings.lede: Thirty five centimetres. A pocket spring core beneath a comfort layer that lifts out. Made after you order it, in the size you ask for.

settings.heading: The core
settings.body:
Thirty centimetres of individually pocketed springs. Each one moves alone, so one person turning over does not move the other side of the bed.

This is the part that lasts. Pocket springs do not soften the way foam does, and a well-built core is still doing its job at year twenty. It carries a twenty five year guarantee.

settings.label: 30cm
settings.text: Pocket spring core. Individually housed springs, edge to edge. No shared coils, no shared movement.

settings.label: 5cm
settings.text: Comfort layer. Built separately, dropped in, zipped closed. The part your body actually touches, and the only part that softens.

settings.label: 35cm
settings.text: Finished depth. It is what fitting a full core and a proper comfort layer into one bed requires.

settings.heading: The layer
settings.body:
Five centimetres, built as its own product rather than glued into the mattress. It sits under the top panel and comes out with a zip.

Every mattress you have thrown away was thrown away because of five centimetres.

Underneath, the core was almost certainly still sound. Renewing the layer keeps the bed right for twenty five years, and it is why the feel can be settled after you own it rather than guessed at before.

Two minutes to change. No tools.

settings.heading: Made after you order
settings.body:
Nothing is built before somebody wants it. No warehouse, no stock, no last season's tension to move on.

That is why it takes weeks rather than days, and why there is no clearance sale. It is also why the size range is what it is - a size exists because someone asked for it, not because a machine was already set up.

settings.label: Springs pocketed
settings.text: To your size. Built for your order.

settings.label: Layers assembled
settings.text: Core and comfort layer built separately, then brought together.

settings.label: Cover closed
settings.text: Knitted fabric, tape-edge finished, zip fitted along the top panel.

settings.label: Compressed and rolled
settings.text: So it reaches your bedroom in one piece. It expands within hours of being unrolled.

settings.heading: Fifteen sizes
settings.lede: British, European, American and Australian. Including the ones that are hard to buy well.
settings.table_note: Every size, one construction. Thirty five centimetres throughout.

settings.heading: You do not choose the feel. You discover it.
settings.text: Sleep on it for a month. Tell us how it should feel. We make it that way.

settings.heading: It arrives finished.
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unrolled onto your bed. The old one leaves with it.

settings.heading: It stays right for twenty five years.
settings.text: The part that softens renews. The part that lasts, lasts.

settings.heading:
A bed that becomes yours,
and stays that way.
